html: [קְרַץ] n. [m.] piece (𝔗; v. BH קרץ);—pl. sf. קַרְצ֫וֹהִי Dn 6:25, -צֵיהוֹן 3:8, both in phr. אֲכַ֫לוּ ק׳, i.e. accuse maliciously (so 𝔗 Syriac PS 3756 (cf. Old Aramaic אמר כרצי פ׳ Lzb 299 SAC 66 Cooke 205 f.; כרץ also Mand.), prob. borrowed from Assyrian karṣe akâlu, malign, slander (often; also TelAm.); cf. also uḳtarrizu Ḫamm Law 161; further Arabic أَكَلَ لَحْمَهُ id., and kindred phr.; Ethiopic በሊዐ: ሥጋ: Di 489).
